text.p: Following are the main election campaign-related events scheduled for Wednesday.
- Prime Minister John Major makes visit to marginal constituency in South-East England.
- Labour economics spokesman Gordon Brown, education and employment spokesman David Blunkett and social security spokeswoman Harriet Harman hold news conference in London (1030 GMT)
- Labour's overseas development spokesman, Clare Short, speaks at Overseas Development Administration, London.
- Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind to deliver speech on European Union in The Hague.
- Labour leader Tony Blair visits youth training centre in West Midlands.
- Labour deputy leader John Prescott continues regional tour, visiting Bristol, Cardiff, Chepstow and the Forest of Dean.
